faq.question: Is camera batteries allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Camera Batteries is allowed in carry-on luggage. Spare rechargeable lithium camera batteries must be carried in carry-on baggage only.

faq.question: Can you pack camera batteries in checked baggage?
faq.answer: No, Camera Batteries is not allowed in checked bags. Spare camera lithium batteries are prohibited in checked luggage due to safety rules.
